7.5.2.1 Transmit Data via ’Immediate Buffer Access’ Mode
This chapter defines a data transfer requested by an upper layer (e.g. COM, DCM etc.)
via ’Immediate Buffer Access’ Mode.
PduR
FrTp
LSduR
FrIf
01. FrTp_Transmit (TxSDU-ID, …)
02. Evaluate TxSDU-ID
03. Allocate fee channel and set connection
04. Set Flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE (TxSDU-ID)
05. FrTp_Main
06. Call routine PduR_FrTpCopyTxData (TxSDU-ID, ..)
07. Allocate fee TxPDU-ID
08. Call routine PduR_FrTpCopyTxData (TxSDU-ID, ..)
09. Prepare Address Information and PCI
10. Call routine LSduR_FrTpTransmit (TxPDU-ID)
12. LSduR_FrIfTxConfirmation
11. Call routine FrIf_Transmit (TxPDU-ID)
13. Call routine FrTp_TxConfirmation and set TxPduState = „Idle“
14. FrTp_Main
IF:
15. FlowControl reception is expected
THEN:
16. Wait until FlowControl is received
ELSE:
17. Continue at Step 18
IF:
18. All SDU data transmitted
THEN:
19. Free Channel
20. Reset Flag TX_SDU_AVAILABLE
21. Call Pdu_TxConfirmation (TxSDU-ID, ..)
ELSE:
22. Continue at Step 8
